description:
NeuroHire is looking for a motivated and talented Software Developer to join our team. In this role, you will contribute to developing, testing, and maintaining software applications while collaborating with team members to build reliable, scalable, and efficient technology solutions.
 You will apply your programming knowledge, problem-solving skills, and understanding of software development principles to support application development and improve existing systems. This position is ideal for an early-career professional who is passionate about coding, learning new technologies, and building practical software solutions.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop, test, debug, and maintain software applications based on project requirements.
 Write clean, efficient, reusable, and maintainable code following software development best practices.
 Collaborate with developers and cross-functional team members to design and implement software features.
 Work with programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
 Assist in developing and integrating REST APIs and web application components.
 Work with databases and SQL to store, retrieve, and manage application data.
 Identify and troubleshoot software defects, performance issues, and technical challenges.
 Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality.
 Use Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
 Write and execute unit tests to help ensure software reliability and functionality.
 Assist in documenting technical processes, application features, and development workflows.
 Learn and apply new tools, frameworks, and technologies to support ongoing development projects.
 Requirements 
 Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field .
 0–1 year of experience in Software Engineering, Software Development, or a related technical role.
 Strong understanding of programming fundamentals and object-oriented programming.
 Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript .
 Familiarity with data structures and algorithms.
 Understanding of REST APIs and web application fundamentals.
 Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, and basic database concepts.
 Experience using Git and GitHub for version control.
 Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) principles.
 Familiarity with debugging, testing, and writing maintainable code.
 Strong analytical thinking, debugging, and problem-solving abilities.
 Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to changing project requirements.
 Strong communication, teamwork, and collaboration skills.
 Motivation to build reliable software and continuously improve technical skills.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Academic projects, internships, or personal projects involving software development.
 Familiarity with frontend frameworks such as React or backend frameworks such as Node.js, Django, or Spring Boot.
 Basic knowledge of cloud platforms, software deployment, or CI/CD concepts.
 Familiarity with Agile development practices and collaborative engineering workflows.
 Benefits 
 Opportunity to contribute to an innovative, AI-powered technology company.
 Hands-on exposure to software development projects and real-world technical challenges.
 Opportunities to strengthen programming, debugging, and software engineering skills.
 Collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
 Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
 Opportunity to work with modern development tools, technologies, and engineering practices.
 A chance to contribute ideas and develop practical solutions that support business objectives.
 If you are passionate about coding, building software, and solving technical challenges, we encourage you to apply and begin your software development journey with NeuroHire .
